rows: Stalking: You hide yourself from view and begin to stalk. Works most effectively when behind your opponent.

Devious Foe : You evade attacks with uncanny dexterity and strike with speed and power. Damage is increased by 8%, dodge chance is increased by 5%, and attacks refresh 10% faster. While in this form your Deadly Strike and Vicious Strike attacks deal additional damage and the hatred generated by your attacks is increased by 5%.
